name: lash.dev_test
doc: Run the change-scoped developer tests in a fork (`. ./env.sh && python3 scripts/dev-test.py`, `--dependents` and `--base` when given) and read its receipt. Succeeds either way unless require_ok: `ok` is true only when it passed and the checkout did not change during the run; `commands` are what it selected and `tested` says whether any of them ran tests. With require_ok, a red (or a checkout that changed during the run) fails the step, so nothing after it runs. With require_tests, a selection that runs no tests fails the step. With dry_run, returns the plan without running it.
